title: 3dWarpDrive
description: Warp a dataset to match another one (the base) using an affine transformation.

base_dataset.description: Load dataset as the base to which the input dataset will be matched. This is a mandatory option.
base_dataset.title: Base dataset

prefix.description: Sets the prefix of the output dataset. If 'NULL', no output dataset is written.
prefix.title: Output prefix

bilinear_general.description: 39 parameters (3 + 3x3 + 3x3x3). Not implemented and will never be.
bilinear_general.title: Bilinear General

input_dataset.description: Specify the input dataset anywhere in the command line option list.
input_dataset.title: Input dataset (alternative option)

verbosity_flag.description: Print out lots of information along the way.
verbosity_flag.title: Verbose Flag

summary_file.description: Save summary of calculations into text file. If value is '-', summary goes to stdout.
summary_file.title: Summary file

max_iterations.description: Allow up to 'm' iterations for convergence.
max_iterations.title: Max Iterations

delta.description: Distance, in voxel size, used to compute image derivatives using finite differences. [Default=1.0]
delta.title: Delta for Finite Differences

weight.description: Set the weighting applied to each voxel proportional to the brick specified here. [Default=computed by program from base]
weight.title: Weight Dataset

convergence_thresh.description: Set the convergence parameter to be RMS 't' voxels movement between iterations. [Default=0.03]
convergence_thresh.title: Convergence Threshold

twopass.description: Do the parameter estimation in two passes, coarse-but-fast first, then fine-but-slow second.
twopass.title: Two-Pass Estimation

final_mode.description: Set the final warp to be interpolated using 'mode'.
final_mode.title: Final Interpolation Mode

parfix.description: Fix the n'th parameter of the warp model to the value 'v'. More than one -parfix option can be used.
parfix.title: Fix Parameters

oned_file.description: Write out the warping parameters to this file.
oned_file.title: Warping Parameters File

float_format.description: Write output dataset in float format, even if input dataset is short or byte.
float_format.title: Float Format Output

coarserot_init.description: Initialize shift+rotation parameters by a brute force coarse search.
coarserot_init.title: Coarse Rotation Initialization

oned_matrix_save.description: Save base-to-input transformation matrices in specified file. If the file does not end in '.1D', the program will append '.aff12.1D'.
oned_matrix_save.title: Transformation Matrices File

sdu_order.description: Set the order of the matrix multiplication for the affine transformations (S=triangular shear, D=diagonal scaling matrix, U=rotation matrix).
sdu_order.title: Matrix Order SDU

sud_order.description: Set the order of the matrix multiplication for the affine transformations (S=triangular shear, U=rotation matrix, D=diagonal scaling matrix).
sud_order.title: Matrix Order SUD

dsu_order.description: Set the order of the matrix multiplication for the affine transformations (D=diagonal scaling matrix, S=triangular shear, U=rotation matrix).
dsu_order.title: Matrix Order DSU

dus_order.description: Set the order of the matrix multiplication for the affine transformations (D=diagonal scaling matrix, U=rotation matrix, S=triangular shear).
dus_order.title: Matrix Order DUS

usd_order.description: Set the order of the matrix multiplication for the affine transformations (U=rotation matrix, S=triangular shear, D=diagonal scaling matrix).
usd_order.title: Matrix Order USD

uds_order.description: Set the order of the matrix multiplication for the affine transformations (U=rotation matrix, D=diagonal scaling matrix, S=triangular shear).
uds_order.title: Matrix Order UDS

supper_s_matrix.description: Set the S matrix to be upper triangular.
supper_s_matrix.title: Upper Triangular S Matrix

slower_s_matrix.description: Set the S matrix to be lower triangular.
slower_s_matrix.title: Lower Triangular S Matrix

ashift.description: Apply the shift parameters after the matrix transformation.
ashift.title: Shift After Transformation

bshift.description: Apply the shift parameters before the matrix transformation.
bshift.title: Shift Before Transformation
